I could tell she wasn’t her super confident self and clumsily let a plate I’d passed her fall onto the floor.  Then she told me something.  “Oh you know who he is don’t ya?”  “He’s the man!”  “He’s the main man!”  “He’s the head!”  “He’s the head of the  Klan!”  Then she told me that he really likes me and it would help her husbands business dealings with him if I took in nibbles into his study while they discussed business. 

I’ve only told this because it’s also important to be aware of that just because someone has been invited by someone with a dubious past, it does not necessarily make them culpable, as in my case, I was innocent 😇 and had no idea 🤷‍♀️ of my host families connections. So as always, banger video, basically a full documentary, but I’ve got one small issue. At 40:19 you say “Their target is an active Antifa couple in the Georgia area.” That suggests that there is THE Antifa, which is how this is increasingly portrayed in mainstream media, even though that’s just not true.
Quick explanation: Antifa stands for antifascist (action), so an action, for example a protest, that is labeled as antifascist. Of course there are also groups that describe themselves as antifascist, and honestly everyone should be antifascist anyway, but you are not “the Antifa” and you are not “active in the Antifa.”
In my view, this creates a false image and reinforces this misconception of THE Antifa, which gives fascists an easy target. It lets them lump individual actions by individual people or groups together with all people who are antifascist.
Obviously this is just a small slip in the script and I don’t think it’s that deep, but it immediately stood out to me and I wanted to mention it.
